title: Mental Health Equity in LLMs: Leveraging Multi-Hop Question Answering to Detect Amplified and Silenced Perspectives

bias_targets.methodology: Formulating targeted multi-hop questions combining multiple identity factors (e.g., race, gender, socioeconomic status) and mental health conditions to identify how biases magnify through sequential reasoning steps.
Evaluating LLM responses to multi-hop questions utilizing source posts categorized by age groups (Child, Young-Adult, Adult, Senior) in the context of mental health.
Evaluating LLM responses to multi-hop questions utilizing source posts categorized by gender (Male, Female) in the context of mental health.
Evaluating LLM responses to multi-hop questions utilizing source posts categorized by race (e.g., Asian, Black/African American, White, Hispanic/Latino) in the context of mental health.
Evaluating LLM responses to multi-hop questions utilizing source posts categorized by income levels (Low-Income, Middle-Income, High-Income) in the context of mental health.
Measuring disparities in sentiment, tone, and demographic framing across LLM responses to various psychiatric conditions (e.g., depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder, addiction).
